meta.title: Kiln Yoga | Small yoga studio in Peckham, London
meta.description: A warm, small yoga studio above a bakery in Peckham. Only 14 mats. Slow flow, yin, a 4 week beginners course and pregnancy yoga on Saturdays.

rationale: The site is meant to feel like the room: warm, unhurried, a little handmade. A pale sage background with a baked clay accent and soft rounded shapes echo the wooden floor and the bakery below. Young Serif gives friendly, soft headlines, Karla keeps the text plain and easy. A featured service plus list suits a studio with one main offer and a few others, and a hand drawn plan of the 14 mats and a note from Mei carry the personality instead of stock imagery.

props.headline: Fourteen mats, one warm room above the bakery
props.sub: A small yoga studio in Peckham. Wooden floor, big windows, and on early mornings the smell of bread coming up the stairs. Classes stay small so you are seen, not herded.

photo.subject: The studio room in morning light: wooden floor, big windows, a few mats laid out in rows, no people, warm natural light

props.label: Classes
props.title: What we practise
props.intro: Slow flow is the heart of the timetable. The rest are there for the days you need something different.

featured.name: Slow flow
featured.description: Unhurried movement linked with breath, with time to stay in each shape. Mei teaches most of these classes. With only 14 mats you get real attention, and nobody needs to keep up with anybody.

photo.subject: Mei guiding a small group in a slow flow pose on the wooden floor, window light behind, relaxed faces, no staging

others.name: Yin
others.description: Long, quiet holds on the floor with bolsters and blankets. A slow evening for tired bodies.

others.name: Pregnancy yoga
others.description: Saturday mornings. Gentle movement and breathing, with other people at the same stage.

others.name: Single classes and class pass
others.description: Drop in for one class, or take a class pass if you plan to come often.

props.label: Beginners
props.title: A 4 week course for your first time on a mat

steps.name: Week one
steps.detail: Arrive, find a mat, learn how to stand, sit and breathe. No one asks you to touch your toes.

steps.name: Week two
steps.detail: The basic shapes, one at a time, with plenty of time to ask questions.

steps.name: Week three
steps.detail: Linking the shapes into a short, slow sequence you can follow.

steps.name: Week four
steps.detail: A full gentle class, and a plan for what to try next if you want to carry on.

props.label: Your teachers
props.title: Hello, I'm Mei
props.text: I opened Kiln because I wanted a yoga room that felt like someone's home, not a gym with a mat rental desk. I teach most of the classes myself, and two other teachers cover the rest. We keep it small on purpose. If you come twice, we will know your name. If you have an injury, a bump or a bad week, tell us at the door and we will adjust things for you.

photo.subject: Portrait of Mei, the owner, sitting on the studio floor with a mug, relaxed and looking toward the camera, natural window light

props.text: Come ten minutes early. Take your shoes off, say hello, and grab a cup of tea. The bread smell is free.

items.q: I have never done yoga. Can I just turn up?
items.a: Yes, but the 4 week beginners course is the kindest way in. You start with the same small group each week and learn the basics at an easy pace.

items.q: How many people are in a class?
items.a: There are only 14 mats, so never more than 14 people. That is why the room feels calm.

items.q: Do I need to bring a mat?
items.a: Please bring your own if you have one. If you do not, ask us before your first class and we will sort something out.

items.q: Can I do yoga while pregnant?
items.a: Our pregnancy class runs on Saturday mornings. Tell us how far along you are and we will take it from there. It is always a good idea to check with your midwife or doctor too.
Book a single class to try us out. If you find yourself coming often, a class pass is the better way to go.

props.label: Visit
props.title: Find us above the bakery
props.address: Kiln Yoga, above the bakery, Peckham, London SE15
props.directions: Look for the bakery shopfront. The door to the stairs is to the right of it. Walk up one flight and the studio is straight ahead.
